title: Everything your labour consultancy needs, connected in one platform.
description: LabourFlow brings client management, compliance, payroll, documents, communication and team operations together in one workspace built for labour law consultants.

modules.title: Client Management
modules.description: Manage unlimited client companies, branches and employee rosters from one centralized, searchable workspace with compliance applicability, expiry tracking and activity history.

modules.title: Compliance Management
modules.description: Configure the labour laws and statutory requirements that apply to each client, including PF, ESI, PT, LWF, minimum wages, bonus, gratuity, contract labour and establishment requirements.

modules.title: Compliance Calendar
modules.description: Track recurring statutory deadlines, returns, renewals and filing responsibilities across every client with centralized schedules and automated reminders.

modules.title: Payroll & Statutory Calculations
modules.description: Process attendance and salary calculations with PF, ESI, PT, LWF, bonus and gratuity, then generate payslips, challans and statutory outputs.

modules.title: Document Management
modules.description: Securely organize GST, PAN, licences, DSCs, agreements, certificates and other client records with expiry tracking, version history, search and bulk download.

modules.title: Notices & Reminders
modules.description: Track government notices, reply deadlines, penalties and required documents while sending automated WhatsApp and email reminders for compliance and document follow-ups.

modules.title: Task & Team Management
modules.description: Assign compliance work to consultants and staff, monitor priorities and deadlines, track completion and maintain an audit trail across your consultancy.

modules.title: Client Portal
modules.description: Give clients a secure, branded space to upload documents, view compliance status, check upcoming deadlines, receive notifications and download reports.

modules.title: Employee Portal
modules.description: Give consultancy staff role-based access to assigned clients and tasks, due-date views, work uploads, completion tracking and personal performance visibility.

modules.title: Reports & Analytics
modules.description: Monitor compliance performance, pending returns, overdue work, client activity, staff productivity and business metrics through centralized reports and dashboards.

modules.title: Integrations & Automation
modules.description: Connect communication, government, storage and payment services including WhatsApp, email, SMS, GST, Aadhaar, DSC, government portals, Google Drive and Dropbox.

modules.title: AI Compliance Assistant
modules.description: Ask questions in natural language, search client compliance data, identify upcoming risks, read government notices and surface compliance actions that need attention.
